name: Southern Toothed Viburnum
desc: Southern Toothed Viburnum (Viburnum scabrellum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Viburnum scabrellum, the southern toothed viburnum, is a species of flowering plant in the family Viburnaceae, native to the central and southeastern United States.
